parts.text: What happens to the remaining undigested food?

options.text: It moves into the large intestine.
It moves from the large intestine into the small intestine.
The digested nutrients move into the large intestine after absorption.
It passes through the small-intestine wall into blood vessels.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem:
Reyansh traces food after most nutrients have been digested and absorbed in the small intestine. He considers the remaining undigested food, the large intestine, and blood vessels in the small-intestine wall.

Answer both parts.

part_answers.answer: After most nutrients are absorbed in the small intestine, the remaining undigested food moves on into the large intestine; it does not re-enter the small intestine or pass into blood as undigested food.

teacher.key_rationale: Undigested remains continue into the large intestine after small-intestine digestion and absorption; digested nutrients do not head to the large intestine for absorption, and undigested food does not enter blood vessels.
